finding.title: Final scratch/free observation omitted before deletion
finding.trigger: The worker writes profile or cache after the final 250 ms work checkpoint and exits; finally removes scratch after owned-group cleanup without observing its final size or free space.
finding.effect: A final observable cap breach can be erased and a run reported PASS based only on an earlier sample. This is an evidence/classification defect in the runner, not a demonstrated product failure.
finding.requestedFix: After own process-group absence and before scratch removal, sample free bytes, scratch logical/allocated and retained evidence. Report breached thresholds or sampling errors, still perform own cleanup. Keep total deadline, final evidence reserve, no work-deadline checkpoint in cleanup.
